## This week

Orientation (grading, weekly rhythm, presentation assignment) followed by the first lecture: what separates an agent from a chatbot. An agent is a system whose control flow is decided by the model's output; the lecture builds that definition from what an LLM call can and cannot do, then covers the agent loop, the components (Model · Instructions · Tools · Memory), the autonomy spectrum, workflow patterns, and form factors — and closes with the course map: build the agent (W2–4), discipline it (W5), scale it (W6–7), ground and operate it (W9–13).

## Lab

`W1_lab_setup.ipynb` — paste your API key into the setup cell and run top to bottom in Colab: first calls through `aisuite`; message roles, statelessness, temperature; and a final task — a system prompt that makes every answer come back as clean JSON (checked PASS/FAIL).

Run it in Colab: click **Open in Colab** above (or download the `.ipynb` and upload it to [colab.research.google.com](https://colab.research.google.com)), then run top to bottom. **Prerequisite:** your own API key — follow the [API Setup Guide](api-setup.qmd) *before* class.

## Presentations

No paper presentation in Week 1 — presenter slots are assigned during orientation and presentations begin in Week 2 with Chain-of-Thought ([Wei et al., 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.11903) ([PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2201.11903))). Before your slot, read the [presentation guide](presentations.qmd) and study the sample deck linked there.
